svg.title: E-commerce packaging: courier carton with label and FRAGILE tape, and an open printed mailer box
svg.desc: Shipping packaging for online orders: a 3-ply corrugated carton with a courier label and printed FRAGILE tape, a closed mailer with a tear strip for easy opening, and an open mailer with paper void fill and a folded T-shirt.

g.text: MADE WITH CARE · RETURN LABEL INSIDE
